lesson_intro.heading: Cloud Operations Associate · PM-4.1
lesson_intro.board_text:
S3 Fundamentals and Security
Finova · finova-dev · ap-south-1

Why before how:
Object storage holds receipts, KYC images, exports — trust lives here.

Mental model:
Bucket = container. Object = file. Block Public Access is your seatbelt.

You will: watch → learn → practice one navigation.
lesson_intro.ren_voice: I am Ren. Object storage holds receipts, KYC images, exports — trust lives here. Mental model: Bucket = container. Object = file. Block Public Access is your seatbelt. I demonstrate, then you practice. Least privilege and Region discipline stay non-negotiable.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
S3 Fundamentals and Security
• Bucket = container. Object = file. Block Public Access is your seatbelt.
• Mistake: Public bucket 'for testing' in a shared account.
• Habit: Account BPA on. Prove public access is impossible before you celebrate.
